## Privacy and security review

- [ ] No credentials, cookies, tokens, authorization headers, browser profiles, or private account data were added
- [ ] No new permissions were added, or each permission is explained below
- [ ] No new network destination was added, or each destination is explained below
- [ ] No storage field or data collection was added, or privacy documentation is updated
- [ ] No remote code, dynamic evaluation, unsafe HTML insertion, analytics, advertising, or premium-access bypass was introduced
- [ ] Catalog requests still omit credentials where applicable
- [ ] The package contains only allowlisted runtime files
- [ ] `PRIVACY.md`, `SECURITY.md`, and store disclosures are updated if data flow or permissions changed

### Permission, network, storage, or privacy changes

Write `None` or describe the change and rationale.

## Documentation and release impact

- [ ] `README.md` and living specifications are updated where needed
- [ ] Non-obvious decisions are appended to `docs/DECISIONS.md`
- [ ] Beta, publishing, testing, privacy, and security documentation remain accurate
- [ ] Version bump is included if behavior or packaging changed
- [ ] Screenshots are included for visible UI changes

## Notes

List skipped checks, known limitations, follow-up work, and reviewer guidance.
